info.title: Engram
info.description: The Engram control plane over HTTP (ADR 0027): every route calls the Plane; no authentication in v0, so the server answers on loopback only.

post.summary: Write one item through the write gate; 200 with the decision's event.

400.description: the request fails its schema, or the plane refused the call (InvalidCallError)

403.description: the Host or Origin is not this loopback server's, or the actor may not explain this read

404.description: no such route, or the read id names no read event

413.description: the body is over the size limit

500.description: an unexpected error; the body carries no internals

Actor.description: Who acts, as the caller asserts it (no authentication in v0, ADR 0027): id, the level it reads as, its member scopes, and the provenance kind of what it writes.

item.description: A MemoryItem (#/components/schemas/MemoryItem) as the caller assembles it; the plane validates it and denies an invalid one with the event engram/write/schema.

at.description: The time of the call, UTC ISO 8601; the server's clock when absent.
The time of the call, UTC ISO 8601; the server's clock when absent.

policy.description: The policy the read was decided under: <id> v<version>.

StoreSync.description: What the workspace did before the read, as the store's owner: its retention sweep, then the adoption of the store's own memories (ADR 0025, decision D8).

counts.description: The counts the read event's reason records (core's readCounts, decision 5 of the Gate B plan); null for a read event written before that format. Audit data for the human inspector: out_of_reach counts items outside the reader's reach, which decision D5 keeps from the reader, so a surface that answers a model (the MCP tools, the pi extension) must not pass the counts on.

ReadCounts.description: The counts a read event's reason records: returned of candidates, the filtered total and its categories, and the projected items outside the reader's reach (never candidates).
